episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: Detective Taekrok gets a prank call. The unknown caller says something he cannot ignore.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: Taekrok is framed for murder and gets interrogated. He delves into the past cases he undertook.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: Taekrok is appalled by a mistake he made in the past and becomes suspicious of everyone around him.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: Taekrok tells Jinhan about the blackmailer. He grasps the blackmailer's identity but danger awaits.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: Seonga and Gyeongchan decide to help Taekrok, who realizes the blackmailer's target is not him.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: Taekrok chases a man who has a key to the truth. However, the man resists.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.summary: Taekrok sees another death. He grasps the identity of the murderer and prepares for a counterattack.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.summary: The blackmailer puts people around Taekrok in danger. The final game ends only if one of them dies.

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: Taekrok has conflicts with his team leader Yeon Juhyun. Seonga struggles in a juvenile theft probe.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: Seonga gets injured, and Taekrok tries to uncover the truth. Meanwhile, Gyeongchan doubts Taekrok.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: Taekrok finally executes his plan to bring down Lee Youngho. Odd cooperation with Juhyun ensues.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: Taekrok tries to secure the testimony of Team Leader Han, the only witness to capture Lee Youngho.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: An unknown armed force appears. The election draws near, and Lee Youngho attacks Dohyung.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: Juhyun suffers a severe injury while Taekrok faces a crisis. The identity of their foes is unveiled.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.summary: Taekrok faces his past and delves into the root of the problem; Seonga and Gyeongchan face unfair treatment; Juhyun takes a risky step to uncover the truth; Taekrok is determined to protect his loved ones at all costs.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.summary: Veteran detective Taekrok heads to the final battle. The die is cast, and there is no turning back.
